function: CSI compression, feedback and recovery with polarization-disentangled representations of dual-polarized downlink CSI (pp. 1, 4).
system: FDD massive MIMO-OFDM downlink: BS with 32 dual-polarized antennas, single-antenna UE, 32 subbands, 3.5 GHz, 10 MHz bandwidth, no RIS (pp. 3, 9).
method: Convolutional-attention encoder and decoder with separate FC layers; disentangles shared and polarization-specific CSI with a mutual-information regularizer; MSE loss, trained offline (pp. 5-9).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-A/B/C (CDL-D for LoS) at 3.5 GHz; 100,000 training, 20,000 validation, 20,000 test samples; QuaDRiGa for extra tests (pp. 9-10, 14).
test_conditions: Default CDL-A, separate user sets for train and test; cross-scenario tests among CDL-A/B/C, a model trained on all three, and CDL-A versus QuaDRiGa (pp. 10, 14).
baselines: CsiNet, CRNet, ACRNet-1x and ACRNet-5x for NMSE and complexity; CsiNet, CRNet, Type I and Type II codebooks for achievable rate (pp. 10, 15).
metrics: NMSE (CDF), number of parameters, inference time, feedback bits, achievable rate per user with ZF precoding (pp. 10-15).
complexity: Parameters: 695K (sigma=8) down to 160K (sigma=64), total 1.481M versus 1.986M for ACRNet-1x; encoder and decoder inference time at sigma=8 (Table II, Fig. 8, pp. 11-12).
openness: Data stated available on-line at https://github.com/SEUshf/DiReNet (p. 1).
q1_support: p. 9: "we generate the training set, validation set, and testing set through CDL channel models defined in 3GPP specification TR 38.901".
q2_support: p. 14: "testing the QuaDRiGa channel on a network trained by the CDL-A channel and testing the CDL-A channel on a network trained by the QuaDRiGa channel"; Fig. 12 also tests CDL-A, CDL-B and CDL-C models trained on another scenario.
q3_support: p. 10: "existing DL-based methods ... include CsiNet [19], CRNet [22], and ACRNet [23]" (NMSE); p. 15: "CsiNet [19], CRNet [22] and our proposed DiReNet, along with two codebook-based methods, i.e., Type I and Type II [7]" (achievable rate).
q4_support: p. 10: "network complexity is measured by the number of parameters"; Table II (p. 11): DiReNet total 1.481M parameters; Fig. 8 (p. 12) gives encoder and decoder inference time.
q5_support: p. 1: "Data is available on-line at https://github.com/SEUshf/DiReNet".
notes: Eligible: learned CSI feedback network, area 2 (compression and feedback of the channel), BS has 32 antennas. The non-learned baselines (Type I and II codebooks) appear only in the achievable-rate comparison (p. 15); the NMSE comparison is against learned networks only (p. 10), so the reviewer may confirm q3. The footnote says Data is available at a GitHub link; it does not say whether the repository also holds the code (not checked). Quantization uses non-learning uniform quantizers (p. 9). PDF checked: page 1 holds the title and DOI 10.1109/TCOMM.2024.3384256.
